description.zh-CN: simple=简单填充；wave=液体波浪（默认）；sparkle=光点和粒子
description.en: simple = flat fill; wave = liquid wave (default); sparkle = light dots and particles

description.zh-CN: green=绿色；blue=蓝色（默认）；accent=Windows 强调色；custom=使用下面的自定义颜色。放电时按电量自动变绿、黄、红
description.en: green = green; blue = blue (default); accent = Windows accent; custom = use the colour below. On battery it turns green, amber, red by level

description.zh-CN: 仅在充电颜色选 custom 时生效，格式如 #3da9ff
description.en: Only used when the charging colour is custom, for example #3da9ff

description.zh-CN: 沿胶囊边缘加一圈同色描边，勾出液体轮廓。电量由液面长度表达，不再另外画进度环
description.en: Draw a rim around the capsule in the fill colour. The fill length already shows the level

description.zh-CN: 关闭后波浪和光点静止，省电，适合常驻显示
description.en: Turning this off freezes the wave and particles to save power

description.zh-CN: 用电池跌到阈值时在岛上提醒一次，插电或回血后重置
description.en: Notify once when the level drops to the threshold; resets after charging or recovering

description.zh-CN: 电量跌到这个百分比时提醒
description.en: Notify when the level falls to this percentage

description.zh-CN: 充到 100% 时提醒拔掉电源，长期满电插着会加速电池老化
description.en: Notify at 100% so you can unplug; staying full on AC ages the battery faster
